answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via zero-knowledge ePassport nullifiers at registration. To filter a nebula of raw keys, each agent proves a state-signed NFC signature in a zk-SNARK, emitting a domain-bound nullifier as fixed as basalt for deduplication. Attackers incur the scarce cost of securing a distinct physical passport per identity. However, operators on a remote knoll without ePassports face exclusion, and rogue states can issue duplicate certificates.
